feed_title: Orthopaedic Memory Foam Dog Bed 90 x 65cm, Bolster on Four Sides, Waterproof Liner, Washable Zipped Cover, Large | PawLunova Borrowdale
descriptionHtml:
90 × 65cm. Memory foam. An edge whichever way they turn.

Borrowdale is a memory foam orthopaedic dog bed with a bolster on all four sides, Large 90 × 65cm. A waterproof liner sits under the zipped cover.

Some dogs sleep flat out. Others sleep tight and tucked in, and those dogs spend the evening hunting for an edge. They circle on a flat cushion, drop, get up, and end up against the skirting board. Not because it is comfortable. Because it touches them back.

A border on four sides means the edge finds them. Whichever way they turn, something cushioned is already there.

What they get

  • A border on four sides: Cushioned the whole way round, rising to a rim for a chin.
  • A memory foam base: Foam that keeps its shape, not filling that packs into ridges.
  • A waterproof inner liner: Between cover and foam, so a wet night stays off it.
  • A cover that unzips: It lifts off and washes to the sewn-in care label.

Best for: Dogs who curl tight and wedge into corners. If yours sleeps stretched flat, Nocturne suits them better.

Why it is worth the money

£119 is a lot for a dog bed, so here is where it goes. Memory foam instead of loose filling, and a liner between that foam and whatever happens above it. The foam core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee. Across 1825 nights, the five years it runs, that is about 7p a night.

And you are not gambling the money. Inside 100 nights we collect free from the UK mainland and refund in full.

One thing first. Four sides means a side to step over from any direction. A dog already hesitating at a raised edge does better on our low Coniston.

Size and fit

SizeOutside (cm)
Large90 × 65

The border eats into that outside figure, so measure your dog curled rather than stretched. We publish no internal sleeping area here and will not guess one. Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know it will fit?

Measure them curled. The 90 × 65cm is outside the border.

What does delivery cost?

Nothing over £40. Your window shows at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. The options appear at checkout.

Is there an open side?

No. The border runs unbroken, rising to a rim.

Will it suit an older dog who struggles to get up?

We say what it is, not what it does. Memory foam, raised edge every side. Ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

The cover unzips and washes to its label.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Send it back. That is what the 100 nights are for.

Choose the Large and give them an edge on every side.
